description: Searches Buildability's public pages: Zoning Atlas district pages (cited dimensional standards), city zoning source packs, the canonical product and methodology pages, and articles. Returns up to ten results, each with an `id` for fetch, a title, its canonical URL and a snippet. For a specific address, use score_address instead.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "Austin SF-3 setbacks".

name: search

complete.description: False when part of the Atlas could not be read; note says which part.

title: Search Buildability's public pages
